# proxmox_node_subscription (Data Source)

Reads the subscription state of a node from `GET /nodes/{node}/subscription`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_subscription" "sub" {
  node = "pve-1"
}

output "status" {
  value = data.proxmox_node_subscription.sub.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `checktime` (Number)
- `key` (String)
- `level` (String)
- `message` (String)
- `nextduedate` (String)
- `productname` (String)
- `regdate` (String)
- `serverid` (String)
- `signature` (String)
- `sockets` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `url` (String)
